cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Remember Me Correctly
cards.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you caption our missed-boat photo, repeat what I said on the quay. A caption should be accurate, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember you laughing. Not the words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Laughter isn't a quotation. I'll give you the beginning: 'That's the last time we trust...' Complete it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the answer. Was it your watch, my French, or the man selling watches? Choose one, please; we aren't short of evidence.

reason: Use expert caption and answer-format corrections to make the memory test specific, with B generic-caption shortcut causing multiple-choice support.
